name: zmodel_material_set_user_tag
description: zModel_Material::SetUserTag stores a user tag on a non-null material and reports whether the store happened.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481040 validates returning zero on null material, storing the caller-provided tag at material+0x20 for non-null material, and returning one.
The native smoke verifies null rejection and successful userTag assignment.
